PDF Studio PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 browser integration
============================================

This package combines the following upstream projects. It is not
an official PaddlePaddle, Microsoft, Hugging Face, or ONNX Community release.

PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 / PaddlePaddle
  Original model: https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR-VL-1.5
  Source project: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
  License: Apache License 2.0. The original license text is included as
  PaddleOCR-Apache-2.0-LICENSE.txt.
  License source retrieved 2026-09-11:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR/main/LICENSE

ONNX Community conversion
  https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/PaddleOCR-VL-1.5-ONNX
  Pinned revision: ebc8e65ff106df8088bbb3f31ce00bf2fccb24b4
  The conversion's original model card declares license: apache-2.0.
  The complete original model card is included as
  MODEL-CARD.md; model/config/tokenizer files are
  preserved as downloaded. This package uses its Q4 vision/decoder and FP32
  embedding files without changing the ONNX graphs or model weights.

ONNX Runtime Web 1.29.0 / Microsoft Corporation
  https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
  License: MIT. The complete versioned LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices.txt are
  included as onnxruntime-1.29.0-LICENSE.txt and
  onnxruntime-1.29.0-ThirdPartyNotices.txt.
  Sources:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/v1.29.0/LICENSE
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/v1.29.0/ThirdPartyNotices.txt

Hugging Face Transformers.js 4.2.0, Tokenizers.js, and Jinja.js
  https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
  Original installed-package LICENSE texts are included for transformers,
  tokenizers, and jinja. The distributed browser code is bundled/minified;
  retained license comments are preserved by esbuild legalComments:inline.

PDF Studio modifications (2026-09-11)
  The original Paddle image preprocessing, prompt construction, M-RoPE, and
  Spotting output handling were ported to JavaScript in preprocess.mjs.
  Source URLs and assumptions are recorded in that file. The browser resize
  implementation is not claimed to be byte-identical to Pillow.
  session.mjs adds browser inference orchestration and adapts results to
  PDF Studio. The web application uses Paddle for local recognition and
  adds proportional character widths to its searchable-PDF writer.
  Web model delivery splits unchanged source files into verified chunks,
  fetched from the application's origin and reused through CacheStorage.
  These modified browser files and packaging adapters are independent work;
  they do not represent upstream model/runtime endorsement.

Existing PDF Studio notices
  Original PDF Studio PDF/rendering/markup font assets and notices remain in
  the generated application shell. The separate standalone build retains
  Tesseract and its notices; it does not include this web Paddle loader.
